user.title: Add room
user.description: Only give the room thermostats to the HomeKit Bridge, not the TRVs, so that Apple Home shows a single thermostat per room.

data_description.trvs: The radiator thermostats (TRVs) this room controls. All of them get the same target; the room shows the mean of their current temperatures.
data_description.window_contacts: While one of these contacts is open for longer than the window delay, the room gets frost protection. An unreachable contact counts as closed.
data_description.schedule: Schedule helper of the room. During a block its level applies (comfort or night, comfort if none is set), eco outside.
data_description.comfort_temperature: Target temperature during a block with level comfort or without a level.
data_description.night_temperature: Target temperature during a block with level night.
data_description.eco_temperature: Target temperature outside the blocks of the schedule.
data_description.lead_time: The level of a block already applies this long before the block starts, so the room is warm in time.
data_description.area: The room appears as a device in this area.
data_description.override_expiry_policy: When a manual override in this room returns to the schedule.
data_description.override_expiry_duration: Leave empty to use the global override duration.

trv_offline.description: The radiator thermostat {trv} in room {room} has been unreachable for more than 30 minutes, so it does not get new targets. Check the tado bridge and the batteries of the thermostat. This issue disappears by itself once the thermostat is reachable again.
